systems.owner: National Centre for Health System Reform, under the supervision of the Ministry of Health
systems.tiers: Launched in Tripoli in January 2024 with the National Comprehensive Health Care Programme, whose first applied model of digital transformation was within Abu Sleem municipality; it works in health centres, for referral and the electronic health file

note: A health ministry launch: Abu Sleem municipality is named as the place of the health programme's first model, not as a municipal office. Nothing is stated on the connection or systems of municipal government.
